definitions.full: H3047. Yada יָדָע proper name, masculine (Sabean ידע , epithet of king, the knowing, shrewd one Mordt ZMG 1870, 37 ) — a man of Judah 1Chr 2:28 ( יָדָ֑ע ), 2:32 .

occurrences.englishText: The sons of Onam were Shammai and Jada. The sons of Shammai: Nadab and Abishur.
The sons of Jada the brother of Shammai: Jether and Jonathan; and Jether died without children.
